notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 is live now!
notes.content:
Hello there!

 

Some more fixes added to the game:

Fixed bug where using the grappling tongue just one frame before clearing a stage would cause the wrong animation to play.
Fixed bug where, right after using the stomp skill, the grappling tongue and stomp would not work until restarting the stage.
Fixed bug where using the grappling tongue just before entering a vertical pipe would cause Sami to lose speed within the pipe.
Fixed bug where the stomp skill would not work properly if the jump button was pressed at the same time.
Fixed bug where Sami would keep moving during the stage clear animation.
Fixed bug where the fast-forward functionality on the stage intro would not work right after changing difficulty.
Fixed a couple of typos in the English localization.
Fixed bug where some enemies rotation would appear to be wrong while the game is paused.
Fixed bug where Vera glide skill would be triggered with the LB button.
Moved enemy position in stage 4-13 to make it a bit easier to pass through it.

 

If you know about any other issues let us know!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We hope you're enjoying the game so far.
Today we have a few tweaks, adjustments and fixes for you. If there are any changes you like to see or bugs that you have noticed, feel free to leave comments here or join our Discord [url=discord.gg/PGqtuvr]discord.gg/PGqtuvr[/url]
 

Here are the list of fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where you could potentially get stuck in the damage state
[*] Small improvements in the geometry of stages 1-6, 1-13, 2-1 and 2-3
[*] Enemy placement improvement in stage 3-4
[*] Reduced attack rate of Jarsilisk (Snake enemy in world 2)
[*] Slightly slowed down rotating pinball bumpers near the end of stage 2_8
[*] Readjusted lava colliders in Tower of Chaos levels to better match the visuals
[*] Added second tutorial tongue-jump signpost in 1_14
[*] Hangbats and poles now are easier to target with grappling tongue
[/list]

Slightly slowed down rotating pinball bumpers near the end of stage 2_8
